title: StateHash silently collapses to the empty hash for states larger than 4096 bytes, false-greening ODN-11 replay-equality
detail: A state serializing to >4096 bytes makes SerializeState return 0, so StateHash hashes zero bytes — every such state gets FNV64_OFFSET and divergent states compare 'identical'. Canon balance.json pool_max_packets=512 (~24KB of packets) will trigger this in later slices, vacuously passing E10 replay checks.
recommended_fix: Grow the buffer until SerializeState succeeds (or two-pass the needed size), and hard-fail/latch when N==0 in StateHash so an over-large state can never silently hash as empty.

title: StepScenario silently drops logged commands beyond 16 per tick, violating the 'replay applies all log entries' AC
detail: Story 1.2 AC: 'replay applies all log entries for tick N before stepping N → live and replay see identical state at every step boundary [ODN-2]'. Live ApplyEdit applies every command; a tick with >16 log entries silently drops the excess on replay — a silent live/replay divergence. Latent only because slice-1 ticks carry ≤2 entries.
recommended_fix: Fail loud when a tick's entry count exceeds the array (assert/ReplayError), or gather into a growable std::vector<FCommand> so all entries always reach Step.

title: Story 1.1 AC says 'forwarding state in the hash' but the forwarding table is deliberately not serialized (canon-backed)
detail: The implementation deviates from the AC's literal phrase but matches Odin canon exactly (derived table excluded; forwarding outcomes pinned transitively via topology + packet positions, which are hashed). Reconcile the AC wording so future audits don't re-flag it.
recommended_fix: Amend the story-1.1 AC (or add a SCHEMA.md note) stating forwarding state is pinned transitively via serialized topology + packet state, per canon routing.odin.
